description: This file contains utility functions for mapping columns and rows, acting as a compatibility layer between Ant Design Table and react-table in a React project.

methods.name: getSortingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves sorting state (sorted and descending) for a specific header ID from header groups.

methods.name: mapColumns
methods.description: Maps column definitions to a format suitable for rendering, including sorting and rendering logic.

methods.name: mapRows
methods.description: Prepares and maps row data for rendering, adding row IDs and properties.
